response.text:
I can’t reliably report an exact value from a blurry chart. If the axis labels or data values aren’t readable, any “exact” number would be a guess and could be wrong.

I can help in one of these ways — which do you want?
- You upload a higher‑resolution or original image (or the source data). With readable labels I can give the exact value.
- I can attempt a visual estimate from the blurry image and give a range plus a confidence note (this will be approximate, not exact).
- I can walk you through simple image‑enhancement steps (crop, increase contrast/sharpness, zoom) or tools/commands you can use to try to recover the labels.

Tell me which option you prefer and, if you want an estimate, please upload the chart.
